The '''Budget TV''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|750}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Players who select the [[Farm Maps|standard farm map]] during character creation will have this TV inside their house when the game begins. 

Players can view [[television]] programs by {{key|right-clicking}} on the Budget TV.

==Trivia==
* Despite being labeled as the "budget" option, the Budget TV actually costs {{Price|50}} more than the [[Floor TV]].
